title: Correlated Subqueries
description: Find employees who earn more than the average salary of their department. Show employee name, department, their salary, and the department average. Order by salary descending.
hints: A correlated subquery references the outer query's table
SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department = e1.department
Use this subquery in the WHERE clause: salary > (subquery)
Also include it in SELECT to show the department average
